name: Off-Road Vehicle
description: Any vehicle manufactured for off-road use that doesn't meet the federal motor vehicle safety standards for road use when built, such as an off-road electric dirt bike or an ATV. Titled by the Office of Motor Vehicles and identified with an off-road decal. Regulated by Louisiana Revised Statutes §32:299 and Office of Motor Vehicles Policy 82.00.
restrictions: Manufactured for off-road use and not meeting the federal motor vehicle safety standards for road use; no limit on wheels, power or speed
Titled by the Office of Motor Vehicles and issued an off-road decal, renewed every four years; farm use is exempt from the decal
Not designated for road use: kept off public roads except in the narrow cases the statute allows

May use the shoulders of public roads other than interstates, in daylight, only for farm-related activities within five miles of a farm, by an operator with a Class E driver's license; incidental crossings are allowed
Operators must show proof of liability insurance on demand when riding under those exceptions
The motorcycle helmet law doesn't apply when riding under those exceptions
